name: python-batch
title: Python batch application
summary: A dependency-free Python batch job with deterministic synthetic input, offline tests, a Databricks Asset Bundle definition and reviewed GitHub Actions workflows.

supplied_parameters.name: package_name
supplied_parameters.label: Python package name
supplied_parameters.description: Lowercase Python package for the generated source directory.

supplied_parameters.name: synthetic_output_path
supplied_parameters.label: Synthetic output location
supplied_parameters.description: Relative path the batch job writes its synthetic CSV output to.

derived_parameters.name: package_dist_name
derived_parameters.description: Distribution spelling of the package name, with hyphens.

derived_parameters.name: bundle_target
derived_parameters.description: The approved bundle target of the selected environment binding.

derived_parameters.name: synthetic_row_count
derived_parameters.description: Default row count from the binding configuration.

derived_parameters.name: max_runtime_seconds
derived_parameters.description: Job timeout from the binding configuration.
